published_prior_art.cite: ChenHongTarozzi2008 supplies verify-in-sample auxiliary-data moment recovery; BellegoBenatiaDortetBernadet2025 supplies chained DiD under observed-data selection assumptions.
BellegoBenatiaDortetBernadet2025 identifies chained long-run effects from link contrasts; the added recovery step is Theorem 1's validation design.

Manski2003 gives sharp missing-outcome identified regions; FanYu2012 gives sharp partial-identification results in DiD. The finite compatibility LP is their natural intersection, not yet shown to yield a non-routine new characterization.
none found for worst-case fixed-chain ATT-width optimization over nested cohort and outcome audits.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 / Theorem 3 literature positioning
novelty_flags.one_line: tier=letter below novelty_target=field: the current kernel is a straightforward composition of probability-sampling/validation weighting, chained DiD, and finite sharp-bounds machinery; add and distinguish NegiNegi2025 on DiD with latent misclassified treatment and FanYu2012 on sharp DiD partial identification, then supply a non-routine design-specific theorem.

soundness_flags.label: thm:fixed-chain-att and prop:census-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The model never formally requires the comparison cohort to remain untreated on every chain endpoint (for example c=∞ or c>t); without it, the realized θ_c,j need not equal the untreated comparison trend used in the DiD reduction.

soundness_flags.label: prop:beyond-link-mar and prop:blind-cell-witness
soundness_flags.one_line: The witnesses are declared one-link [0,1] laws but are asserted to belong to models with arbitrary fixed K and arbitrary finite calY; state K=1, the relevant chain, ylo=0, yhi=1, and calY containing {1/4,1/2,3/4}, or parameterize the witnesses for the ambient model.

source_verification_receipts.version: Corrected January 20, 2025 author copy for Journal of Econometrics 248, 105783
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper extends chained DiD to selection on observables and then sequential selection on observables/past outcomes using modified pair weights; it does not present a randomized gold-cohort and outcome-retrieval validation design.
The article studies general moment restrictions with missing variables using auxiliary data, including verify-in-sample auxiliary samples and known or unknown missing-data probabilities.
The paper derives the efficiency-bound representation for unconditional moment restrictions with data missing at random, using IPW and an additional conditional moment restriction.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Agricultural Economics version of record, online August 9, 2026
source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 3.2 and 4, especially paragraphs beginning at lines 190–205 of the version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article describes an unbalanced CBS firm panel, annual sampling weights, firm tracking, and imputation based on remaining observations; it does not itself establish the proposed validation-design inputs.
The article studies latent true treatment in two-period panel and repeated-cross-section DiD with differential misclassification, conditional parallel trends, and a parametric correction.
The article establishes sharp partial-identification results for counterfactual and treatment-effect distributions in DiD under extensions of standard DiD assumptions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add an explicit untreated-comparison condition and specialize the one-link witnesses to K=1 with a declared support containing their outcome values.

Expand the closest-literature comparison to Negi and Negi (2025) and Fan and Yu (2012), explaining exactly why randomized validation identifies a regime neither their misclassification nor partial-ID constructions cover.

Promote the audit-design handle into a proved, non-definitional result: a finite optimization algorithm plus a design certificate or a closed-form single-blind-cell width/allocation frontier that is strictly sharper than generic LP formulation.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision only if the angle is recast around a proved non-routine audit-allocation or width-frontier result; otherwise pivot, because the present identification and LP components are letter-tier compositions of established tools.
